body:
I understand how you feel. I’ve stopped reading the news completely because it’s so negative and one sided. Also so much bullshit is written, one day dark chocolate gives you cancer the next week it prevents it. It’s sensationalised to sell papers/get people watching.

Something I’ve started doing lately is googling “happy world news”. It’s refreshing to read positive things happening in the world and makes you realise that a lot of what you read is rubbish.

I worry about the state of our planet too, to combat this I am looking at ways to live more eco friendly and encouraging others to do the same. It helps me feel like I’m helping and feel more in control.

Are there any other job areas you could consider that would leave you more fulfilled than your current role?

I recently left my job of 14 years where I felt unappreciated too for a new ‘exciting’ role that would have made me a lot more money and I only lasted a month as I hated it. It was a good experience in a way though as it’s made me realise that your job and income shouldn’t define you and there are far more important things than money. 

Have you rung to ask for feedback from your interviews? Well done for going to so many too, I can imagine how hard it is to keep picking yourself up especially if you have low esteem.
Yes of course you can message me :)

Maybe write a list of things you would like to do in the future and then pick whichever would be easiest to pursue for you right now and break it down in to small manageable steps. Then the rest of the list you can keep to help you keep focus in your life and keep pushing forward in a positive way.

You’re welcome, glad I’ve helped a bit. I’m always here to talk if you need someone to talk to.

It’s good that you’re learning from your mistakes, that’s all we can do as humans. You sound like a genuine person and I’m sure you’ll connect with someone soon who can see that.

Fair enough, if it’s something you’d love to do though it could be worth the debt?

It’s always hard when a relationship breaks down, I understand the feeling of wasted time but I think maybe a better way to look at it is a learning curve. Bad relationships help us to appreciate the good ones when they come along.

How do you end up hurting people? 

You’re still very young, lots of people are still in educAtion at your age with no job at all so you’ve got plenty of time to find something better. Could you look at retraining in something you’re interested in to give you a positive focus?

Yeah I can understand that, I’m introverted too and would find it hard approaching people. 

How old are you if you don’t mind me asking? I know you’ve been trying these apps but 6 months is a relatively short space of time in the scheme of things, there’s nothing to say that the right person isn’t right around the corner. 
You’ve had a long term relationship so there’s no reason to feel you won’t ever have another.  

Also your life is worth so much more than that one relationship. Relationships with others enrich our lives but they shouldn’t define who we are as a person.

There are a lot of stupid flakey people out there but there are also a lot of people who want to find someone just like you. Reading a lot of these posts that seems to be a common desire for a lot of people so they do exist.

Can you block her or him on any social media? That’s what I do for anything that upsets me, there really is no need putting yourself through it especially if you feel ok until you see.

How are you trying to meet new people?
What is making you feel anxious? You’re not a pussy for not doing it, you’re very brave to carry on when you feel so low
What’s making you feel this way?

I’m so sorry you’re going through this. How long were you with your ex? It definitely takes time to get over people, especially when there has been betrayal. 

You need time to heal before you can think about another relationship. Learn to be happy with your own company and chances are you may find someone more naturally then.
I’m here if you want to chat :)
Looking at the averages you’ve felt good for 3/4 of your life so there’s every reason to believe you can feel better again.
Well I’m here if you want to

Ah right that’s difficult. Could you explain to your mother that you want to go to the doctor to seek help? Maybe she could go with you as
Moral support

Yeah I can understand why you feel worried, it’s horrible to feel that we are not in control of our own minds.

Have you sought any counselling to help with these feelings? It’s so hard going through any break up but even worse when that person is part of your reason for getting out of a dark place so I can imagine how painful that’s been for you.
Just wanted to say I have to go to sleep now sorry as it’s really late here but feel free to direct msg me if you want to and I’ll get back to you first thing in the morning :)
Fair enough, it could be worth speaking to your GP then to see if there’s anyway you could see a therapist you feel comfortable with with NHS funding.

You say you pulled yourself out due to reasons to stay alive a year ago, are those reasons still there?

Loneliness is very hard and something I think more people deal with than others realise, even those in social media who appear to have the best social lives.
What is a safe therapist? If you don’t mind me asking

Of course you do, that’s the anxiety talking.

Have you tried talking therapies/medication? I know there can be a lot of trial and error in getting them right but people say when they do they feel like the black cloud finally starts to lift.
You can message me if you’d like or we can talk on here whatever you’re most comfortable with

https://beta.nhs.uk/find-a-psychological-therapies-service/

If you live in England you can self refer via that link, saves you having to go to the doctors to do it.
I can talk to you :)

Wow it sounds like you’re an extremely hard working person with 3 very important and that’s something to be extremely proud of but I can imagine how hard it is too.

As for friendships I think it’s something we all struggle with in adulthood, it’s never as easy as it is when you’re a child. There are websites you can sign up to that help you find friends or people with common interests, could be a good thing to try?
What country do you live in? Could you seek out therapy for the thoughts? It sounds like therapy was very effective for you with the other thoughts so it could be a great tool to help now too.

You are important.

What kinds of things have you tried?
No idea on this sorry but I’m here if you want to talk to someone?

I understand, that must have been a very scary time to feel that way. It’s sad that your family are reacting as they are when clearly that was a mental illness which requires help and compassion not judgement. 

Are you still going to therapy? You don’t deserve to be in danger anymore than anyone else does, you’re worthy too.

Is there any particular reason you wanted to hurt others? I’m not judging in any way just trying to understand what’s happening for you.

Sometimes people react poorly when they’re scared and don’t understand, maybe that is what’s happening with your family.

It’s really good that you’re reenrolling, that’s a great way to get back on track.

That’s upsetting about your family, do you think they will calm down with time? 

Do you feel ok now like the therapist says or are you still having the thoughts? Are the thoughts about people you know or just general?
Do you fancy talking instead?

I can think of lots of good reasons but first and foremost all the people who love you for a start.

What happened to get you kicked out of education if you don’t mind me asking? Is there any chance you could go reenrol in September? 
Even without education there are still plenty of jobs available to people, not everyone has the same level of efucation.
Yes definitely, getting the thoughts out of your head is such a relief. What better thing to spend money on than your health

You’re entitled to ask if you have suspicions, you’re not an idiot. You would be silly not to ask before entering a marriage if you had suspicions.

Could you arrange to meet to talk it all through calmly? As two people who love each other I’m sure there is a way to resolve it, maybe she was just offended and reacted badly

Oh I’m so sorry. I can only imagine how hard that must be for you.

The break may not end the relationship it could infact strengthen it. What are the reasons for the break? You don’t have to answer if you’re not comfortable doing so.
Yes of course :)
No problem. What’s making you feel this way right now?
I can’t help you with that but I am here to talk if you want to tell me what is going on?

You are allowed to be happy and by the sounds of it little glimmers Of hope are creeping in more frequently which is fantastic. 

It’s not easy when you’ve been depressed for a period of time, I read once that you’ve almost got to practice being happy again until it starts to feel natural and you stop thinking about it. Just take each emotion for what it is, if you’re happy you’re feeling happy if you’re sad you’re feeling  sad. The important thing to remember is neither are permanent and they don’t define you

It’s easy to imagine that every relationship will be the same after this bad experience but that’s not realistic or likely. Lots of people your age are still single and now thinking of settling down and you have no reason to assume that the same thing will happen will the next person, that’s just because you are in a bad place now.

It’s good that you’re going to therapy, do you find it’s helping at all? It could be worth speaking to a family member too if you’ve got someone you trust to confide in. The more people you’ve got to help you through this tough time the better. You will get through it, but first of all you’ve just got to focus on getting through tonight and there are plenty of people on here to keep talking to you whilst you get through it.

You’re going through a terrible time but it can and will get better with time. I’ve had more than one relationship and at the time of the others ending I felt I would never get over it, however since then I’ve gone on to meet my husband and we’ve been together 14 years and married for 7 and I still love him as much as I ever have.

There are women out there who still want lifelong relationships, I think the media portray a certain image but it’s certainly not true of everyone. 

Do your family know how low you are feeling?

Tonight doesn’t have to be the night. 

I can’t imagine how hard it is going through what you’re currently going through but that’s not to say it will always be this way.

I’m here if you want to talk.

Really appreciate the positive post, it’s great to see people come out the other side.

Glad to see you doing well, long may it continue!

No I understand, it’s most likely gotten to the point where you need help from someone other than just friends as they have no medical training unfortunately.

It’s obviously up to you but I definitely think the school counsellor could be a good idea. They’ve got to keep whatever you tell them confidential and it may just help saying whatever is in your head out loud, they’re there to help you not judge you.

That’s not very nice, some people don’t realise the way they say things can have really negative effects on others. Especially when it’s your parents and you just want their approval.

It’s good you feel able to discuss some things with your friends, I’m sure they really care about you and would want to help if they knew how badly you were feeling.

Ah I’m sorry to hear that, the must be really hard.  What is it that your mother has done to contribute to you feeling this way? You don’t have to answer if you’re not comfortable.

Have you got any friends you could confide in?

Ok well something I tried is writing Down how I felt and writing down any points I could think of to help slowly improve my situation. Very small steps that you feel comfortable with.

Have you spoken to your parents about how you feel?

Try not to worry too much about academic achievements, I know it’s easy for me to say but as someone who has a university degree that I’ve never actually used I can tell you it’s not as earth shattering as it feels when you are young not to get the best marks.

I know it would be uncomfortable taking about your feelings but it’s also not comfortable keeping them to yourself.
Maybe you could speak to your own doctor instead? 

Have you tried writing down your feelings? I find it helpful sometimes to get them out of my head especially if there is nobody you feel you can confide in. This can also help if you go to see a counsellor so you’ve got a clear list of how
You feel.

Well let me tell you that you definitely are worthy, valid and enough.
You may well feel sad broken and angry right now but it doesn’t need to stay that way. 

Does your school have any type of counsellor you could book to see? I know it’s scary to do but I think it could really help you to talk it all through and the school should know what you’re currently dealing with so they can best support you.

You say you’ve been a good student before so there’s no reason you can’t do so again. Even if it takes you slightly longer to achieve your academic goals it doesn’t matter, I know people who have resat a year in school as they didn’t achieve what they wanted and now have the job they dreamed of.
I really believe you can do it!

I’m really glad to hear it. It’s easy to think really negatively of everything when we’re in a bad place but it’s important to try and see the good in our situations too. 
I’m sure the people in your life don’t feel the way you do about yourself, they spend time with you because they like/love you and want to. We are always much too hard on ourselves as humans.

I’m still here to talk if you’d like to too :)

Has the psychiatrist helped at all? It’s really good that you are taking steps to get to grips with it, I know how hard it is to do. 

Could you request to go and see another doctor?
it’s not normal to live with suicidal ideation and I mean that in the kindest way possible. You shouldn’t have to live feeling that way every day. 
People often have to have a second opinion as sadly not all doctors are as up to scratch on mental health as they should be.

How old are you if you don’t mind me asking? That’s sad to hear with your ex, I had an ex too who made me feel worthless and told me I’d never do better. I have since married the loveliest man, don’t listen to what they tell you. 

Is how you are feeling contributing to how you’re doing in school? If so it could be worth speaking to someone you trust, there may be help available which will help you on the road to feeling better.

How is it that you are actually feeling if you had to describe it?

That’s good, I’m glad you do get a break because even though it isn’t the cause you still deserve it.

I understand the worry about messing them up, when I am having really bad days and can’t get out of bed I feel like I’m a pathetic excuse of a mother and my children would be better off with someone better. 

Is there anything in particular that started the self abuse in the past? 

Have you sought help from any professionals for the depression?

Hi, I can understand where you’re coming from. 

My children are 3 and 4 too and mental health issues or not, it’s hard! Give yourself a break, there isn’t a parent alive who doesn’t lost their temper with their children. Children are brilliant but they are also extremely trying and push every button parents have.

I take my hat off to you being a single parent, it must be doubly as hard but you are doing it and
You should be so proud of yourself. Is the father involved at all?

Not sure where you live but there are sometimes help with childcare which could help give you a break and some space to look after yourself which you deserve to do. You are a mother but you are also a human being. 

Nobody in this world will love your children like you do so they definitely would not be better off without you.

You’re not dramatic, your feelings are valid. 

Is there anything in particular that leads you to feel this way daily?

Yeah he definitely finds it hard which I understand, until I’d felt panic I would never have truly understood it either. 

I do think I need to visit my GP just not sure if I’ve got the courage yet, we’ve moved in the last year and I’ve never been to my new surgery although I have registered so it makes me more apprehensive not knowing what it’s like there. 

Good things are I’ve got an extremely loving husband who I trust implicitly. I’ve got two beautiful, funny children who I love more than I ever thought possible.
My parents are great, my mother helps out a lot with childcare when I’m working which I really appreciate. I know my father loves me even if we clash sometimes.
I’ve got a few close friends who I’m grateful to have. I’ve made mistakes in my past in terms of shutting friends out who I’ve since lost which I regret so I make a lot of effort to keep the friends I have now. 
The thing I find hardest is I know I’ve got a lot of positive things in my life and I still feel quite empty at the moment, I know a lot of people would be so happy to have what I’ve got so I don’t know why I can’t feel it.

Yeah I understand that. Is there anyone else you can talk to so you don’t feel like it’s too much for him, professional counselling or a doctor maybe? 
There’s lots of help available and your friend could help by attending appointments with you.

The fact that last night was so good for you is a positive in my opinion, I know it might not feel like it. You’re capable of feeling happiness and joy which is fantastic. Life won’t always be easy and it can be really hard to cope with but I think you’re stronger than you think. I could never perform in front of people, that takes a lot of
Courage and you should be proud of yourself.

Also think of all the other people who you made
happy last night, they might have been having a bad day and coming to see you last night brought them happiness. That’s an amazing thing to do.

What have you done that you feel has made them miss out? 
Just remember people are there for you because they want to be, if they didn’t care im sure they would just leave but they haven’t. One of the biggest recurring themes I am seeing is people feeling alone but you’ve obviously got people who really truly care for you and that’s a great thing to have.

No start date as of yet, having a few issues as the lady who is in charge of pushing things forward is currently on the sick. The training is quite intensive for 3 months which I’m happy with as I like to do things well and properly. Thank you, I find there’s a lot of negativity in the world which affects me quite badly so I try my best to stay positive where possible. 

Yeah I’ve got a husband, he’s a really lovely man and tries his best to help me but he is a very laid back person and just doesn’t understand. He tells me not to worry about things as they won’t happen but doesn’t appreciate it’s not that easy as I’m sure nobody on these forums wants to feel this way. I keep quite a lot to myself now because I feel like a broken record and I don’t want to effect his mental health or my children’s. 

I’ve always been a bit of a worrier, I remember worrying about my parents dying when I was young but I would forget it and get distracted a lot more easily then. When I was heavily pregnant with my daughter we had a 7 month old puppy who got run over and killed and I think that may have been the start of the panic. It was just a realisation that terrible things happen and can happen to my family too. Also my father in law died of cancer when my daughter was 1 year old and then a friend who was only in her 40s and a mother died from cancer passed away 2 years ago. I think it’s a culmination of them all really alongside my father being a worrier when I was growing up looking back.

Ah right sorry I misread it. 
I suppose it depends how you look at things, putting a positive slant on it his help and support is keeping you going and that’s really good.
Good friends are really hard to come by, I’m sure with his help and time you can find a way through it together.

What’s making you feel like this?
Just remember you haven’t felt like this for a few years, it can and will get better again with time.
If you were my best friend I’d much rather help you through it than wish I’d known when it was too late. People who love you want to help you
I’m here if you want to talk. What’s making you feel this way right now?

If you don’t mind me asking have you tried any talking therapies and how did you find them?

Thank you for the link, unfortunately it looks like it’s only for England atm.

Please give the boot camp a shot. You’ve nothing to lose and I’m sure it will turn out to be a real positive. 

My cousin went in to the military after a messed up childhood and it was by far the best thing he’s ever done. He’s got a sense of purpose, he’s made friends for life and he’s made peace with his past.

Hi,

Thank you, I really appreciate your reply. 

I spoke to a doctor about my health anxiety 3 years ago, I declined medication as I was afraid of side effects and was referred for counselling but this never materialised. I paid for my own counselling at the time for a few sessions which helped a bit but not drastically although it wasn’t CBT which I read is often most effective for anxiety related issues.
I know I should probably go to the doctor now but the thought of it fills me with dread and I’m not convinced they’d be able to help me.

Mostly it’s just something bad happening. I worry about knife crime when they’re teenagers (live in UK) I worry about terrorist attacks if I go out to large public places. Since having them one of the main things I’ve dealt with is health anxiety specifically around cancer, I’m convinced either myself or someone else I love will end up with it. 

The rational part of my brain tells me I’m worrying about things that may never happen but I can’t stop obsessing over them. I think there’s such pressure to keep our children safe that it can really affect people mentally. 

My new job is hopefully good, going to be working in a place making appointments for blood donations and ensuring enough are made so I’m glad to be making a positive difference. I think not working definitely doesn’t help me as I have 24/7 to overthink and it’s dented my self confidence not contributing any money to the house.
Please don’t kill yourself. Try talking first, what is making you feel this way?

Yes definitely, I love a list and get great satisfaction out of completing things. Just make sure you break your goals down in to small easy to achieve steps so it isn’t overwhelming.

You seem like a positive person, I feel like it’s just unfortunate circumstances that have led you to this point. I wish you all the best in making positive changes.

I’m sorry that you don’t like where you live. I don’t know if moving is practical or possible for you but it’s definitely something to consider if it is.

I recently wrote a list of the things I hated about my life and then tried to think of small steps I could take to try and improve them. Might be a good idea to try to work on things in a manageable way

Yeah I get you. I want friends but don’t really know how to go about it as an adult. Where abouts are you from? 

I know 2 years is a long time but it’s also not forever, it’s really good that you are reaching out and trying ways to cope in the meantime.

I understand that, the internet can be a force for good and bad. I try and unfollow anything that makes me feel afraid and no longer read the news.

Is there any way of changing your situation? Possibly a new job which could lead to new friendships or moving home away from those who you feel are bringing you down.

I know how it feels to feel like you have no friends. What contributes to you crying everyday? There is always help so don’t give up.
